name_en: Peony barrage — four to eight white bursts alight at once, upper two thirds
name_zh: 牡丹齐射 — 四到八发白色绽放同时发亮，占据上方三分之二
prompt_en: A massive fireworks barrage against pure black, the grand finale of a victory celebration, at maximum density from the very first frame. The first frame already has four to eight large bursts open and expanding at the same time, spread across the width of the frame, and from there a new burst keeps opening every second or two, so the number of fireworks alight at once never drops below four and the black is never left bare for even a moment. No empty lead-in, no single rocket rising first, no build-up, no pauses between salvos. Each burst is a wide, perfectly round sphere of hundreds of separate sparks flying outward in every direction, each spark a small sharp point of white-hot light dragging one thin bright trail behind it, and the bursts come at every size and every height, big ones overlapping small ones, so their spheres cross and interleave all over the frame. The spheres expand fast, the sparks slow and arc over, their trails thin out and break into flickering fragments that twinkle and go out, while the next bursts are already opening over them. The whole frame stays crowded with thousands of sparks travelling in all directions at once. Only in the last moment of the clip do the final sparks fade and the frame go completely black. The sparks are pure white and silver, brilliant white at the core with only a faint warm tint in the falling tips, and every burst is a dense chrysanthemum of hundreds of needle-thin radiating trails and distinct points rather than a soft glowing cloud. Vertical portrait frame. The bursts fill the upper two thirds of the frame, spread across its width, and the bottom third of the frame stays empty black. The background is pure flat black, completely empty and perfectly still: no smoke, no haze, no mist, no fog, no atmospheric glow, no ground, no horizon, no city, no buildings, no trees, no water, no reflections, no crowd, no silhouettes, no stars, no clouds, no moon. Nothing in the frame is lit except the fireworks themselves. Locked-off static camera, no camera movement, no zoom, no push in, no pan, no tilt, no orbit, no shake, no parallax, no cuts, no scene change. No lens flare, no bloom washing over the whole frame, no vignette, no depth of field, no film grain, no motion blur smear. Every burst opens fully inside the frame and is never cropped by the edges. Clean high-contrast game VFX plate, bright light on black, no text, no numbers, no watermark, no logo, no letterboxing.
prompt_zh: 纯黑背景下的一场大规模烟花齐射，庆祝胜利的压轴终场，从第一帧起就是最大密度。第一帧上就已经有四到八发大型烟花同时炸开并向外扩张，横向铺开；此后每一两秒就有一发新的绽放打开，屏幕上同时发亮的数量始终不少于四发，黑色背景一刻也不会空出来。没有空镜头的铺垫，没有先升起单独一枚的过程，没有酝酿，齐射之间没有停顿。每一发都是一个宽阔而浑圆的球体，数百颗彼此分离的火星朝四面八方向外飞散，每一颗都是细小锐利的白热光点，身后拖着一条细亮的尾迹；绽放大小不一、高度不一，大的与小的彼此重叠，球体在整个画面上交错穿插。球体迅速扩张，火星减速并划弧下坠，尾迹变细、碎成闪烁的碎屑并熄灭，而此时新的绽放已经在它们上方打开。整个画面始终挤满成千上万颗朝各个方向飞散的火星。只有在影片的最后一瞬，残余的火星才淡去，画面才变成全黑。火星是纯白与银白色，核心炽白，只有下坠的尾端带一点极淡的暖色；每一发都是由数百条针一般细的放射状尾迹和清晰光点构成的密集菊花，而不是柔软的发光云团。竖版竖屏画面。绽放集中在画面上方三分之二，横向铺开，画面下方三分之一保持纯黑空着。背景是纯正的全黑，完全空旷、绝对静止：没有烟雾、没有雾气、没有薄雾、没有霭、没有大气辉光，没有地面、没有地平线、没有城市、没有建筑、没有树木、没有水面、没有倒影，没有人群、没有剪影，没有星星、没有云、没有月亮。画面中除了烟花本身，没有任何被照亮的东西。固定机位，镜头完全锁定，无镜头运动、无变焦、无推近、无横摇、无俯仰、无环绕、无抖动、无视差，无剪辑、无场景切换。无镜头光晕，无覆盖整个画面的泛光，无暗角，无景深虚化，无胶片颗粒，无运动模糊拖影。每一次绽放都完整地在画面内展开，绝不被画面边缘裁切。干净的高对比游戏特效素材，黑底亮光，无文字、无数字、无水印、无标志、无黑边。
